description_en: Retrieves the details of an instance
description_zh: 调用GetInstance接口，获取实例的详细信息
name: GetInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173982.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The environment of the workspace, including PROD (production environment) and DEV (development environment)
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间的环境，包括PROD（生产环境）和DEV（开发环境）
parameters.name: project_env

BeginRunningTime.description_en:
The time when the instance started to run.

The value is a 13-digit timestamp, such as `1590416703313`
BeginRunningTime.description_zh:
实例开始运行的时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1590416703313`

BeginWaitResTime.description_en:
The time when the instance started to wait for resources.

The value is a 13-digit timestamp, such as `1590416703313`
BeginWaitResTime.description_zh:
实例开始等待资源的时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1590416703313`

BeginWaitTimeTime.description_en:
The time when the instance started to wait for scheduling.

The value is a 13-digit timestamp, such as `1590416703313`
BeginWaitTimeTime.description_zh:
实例开始等待调度的时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1590416703313`

Bizdate.description_en:
The business date. Typically, this is the day before the node runs.

The value is a 13-digit timestamp, such as `1590336000000`
Bizdate.description_zh:
业务日期。通常为该任务运行时间的前一天。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1590336000000`

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the instance was created.

The value is a 13-digit timestamp, such as `1590416703313`
CreateTime.description_zh:
实例的创建时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1590416703313`

CycTime.description_en:
The scheduled time of the instance.

The value is a 13-digit timestamp, such as `1590422400000`
CycTime.description_zh:
实例的定时时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1590422400000`

DagType.description_en:
The type of the workflow. Valid values:

DAILY(0): Daily scheduling workflow.
MANUAL(1): Manual node workflow.
SMOKE_TEST(2): Smoke test workflow.
SUPPLY_DATA(3): Data backfill workflow.
MANUAL_FLOW(4): Manually run DataFlow or PAI workflow, such as running a workflow in the IDE.
BUSINESS_PROCESS_DAG(5): Manual workflow
DagType.description_zh:
工作流的类型，取值如下：

DAILY(0)：日常调度工作流
MANUAL(1)：手动任务工作流
SMOKE_TEST(2)：冒烟测试工作流
SUPPLY_DATA(3)：补数据工作流
MANUAL_FLOW(4)：手动运行的dataflow pai 业务流程等（如IDE上点击运行业务流程）
BUSINESS_PROCESS_DAG(5)：手动业务流程工作流

DqcType.description_en:
The Data Quality (DQC) type. Valid values:
0: Associated with DQC.
1: Not associated with DQC
DqcType.description_zh:
数据质量DQC类型，取值如下：
0表示有关联dqc。
1表示没有关联dqc

FinishTime.description_en:
The time when the instance finished running.

FinishTime.description_zh:
实例运行的结束时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1590416703313`

ModifyTime.description_en:

ModifyTime.description_zh:
实例的最新修改时间。

PeriodNumber.description_en: The period number, which indicates the cycle sequence of the node instance on the current day
PeriodNumber.description_zh: 周期序号。表示任务实例处于当天的第几轮周期

Priority.description_en: The running priority of the instance. Valid values: 1, 3, 5, 7, and 8. A larger value indicates a higher priority. Default value: 1
Priority.description_zh: 实例运行优先级，取值分为1、3、5、7和8。取值越大，优先级越高。默认优先级为1

RelatedFlowId.description_en: The ID of the associated workflow

RepeatInterval.description_en: The rescheduling interval after a scheduling node fails to run, in milliseconds
RepeatInterval.description_zh: 调度任务运行出错后，重新调整调度频率，单位为毫秒（ms）

Repeatability.description_en: Indicates whether the instance can be repeatedly executed
Repeatability.description_zh: 实例是否可以重复执行

Status.description_en:
The status of the instance. Valid values:

NOT_RUN(1): Not run.
WAIT_TIME(2): Waiting for the scheduled time.
WAIT_RESOURCE(3): Waiting for resources. The node has been delivered to the execution engine and is waiting in the queue for scheduling.
RUNNING(4): Running.
CHECKING(7): Checking. The execution is complete, and the node is delivered to Data Quality for data verification.
CHECKING_CONDITION(8): Checking conditions. The execution is complete, and branch conditions are being verified.
WAIT_TRIGGER(9): Waiting to be triggered. A trigger node changes to this status after the waiting time elapses.
FAILURE(5): Failed.
SUCCESS(6): Successful
Status.description_zh:
任务的状态，取值如下：

NOT_RUN(1)：未运行
WAIT_TIME(2)： 等待时间。等待定时时间到来
WAIT_RESOURCE(3)：等待资源。已经下发到执行引擎，在等待资源排队调度执行
RUNNING(4)：运行中
CHECKING(7)：校验中。执行完毕，下发给数据质量进行数据校检
CHECKING_CONDITION(8)： 条件检测中。执行完毕，正在做分支条件校验
WAIT_TRIGGER(9)：等待触发。触发式节点会在等待时间后变成等待触发
FAILURE(5)：运行失败
SUCCESS(6)：运行成功

TaskRerunTime.description_en:
The number of times the instance can still be rerun. The value can be empty or an integer greater than or equal to 0.
If the value is empty, the automatic rerun count is not configured for the node corresponding to the instance.
If the value is 0, the instance cannot be rerun.
If the value is an integer greater than 0 (assumed as n), the instance can be rerun n times. For example, if the value is 1, the remaining rerun count is 1. If the value is 2, the remaining rerun count is 2, and so on. The initial value is the automatic rerun count defined for the corresponding node plus 1
TaskRerunTime.description_zh:
实例还可以运行的次数。取值可以为空、以及大于等于0的整数。
取值为空，表示该实例对应的节点没有设置自动重跑次数。
取值为0，表示该实例不能再重跑。
取值为大于0的整数（假设为n），表示该实例可重跑次数为n。例如，该参数取值为1，则剩余重跑次数为1，取值为2，则剩余重跑次数为2，以此类推。初始值为对应节点定义的自动重跑次数+1

TaskType.description_en:
The scheduling type of the instance. Valid values:
NORMAL(0): Normal scheduling node. The node is scheduled on a daily basis.
MANUAL(1): Manual node. The node is not scheduled on a daily basis.
PAUSE(2): Frozen node. The node is scheduled on a daily basis, but its status is directly set to failed when the scheduling is triggered.
SKIP(3): Dry-run node. The node is scheduled on a daily basis, but its status is directly set to successful when the scheduling is triggered.
SKIP_UNCHOOSE(4): Unselected node in a temporary workflow. This type of node exists only in temporary workflows, and its status is directly set to successful when the scheduling is triggered.
SKIP_CYCLE(5): Weekly or monthly node that has not reached its running cycle. The node is scheduled on a daily basis, but its status is directly set to successful when the scheduling is triggered.
CONDITION_UNCHOOSE(6): Unselected downstream node. An upstream instance contains a branch (IF) node, but this downstream node is not selected by the branch node. Its status is directly set to dry-run.
REALTIME_DEPRECATED(7): Deprecated real-time generated periodic instance. The status of this type of node is directly set to successful
TaskType.description_zh:
实例的调度类型，取值如下：
NORMAL(0)：正常调度任务。该任务被日常调度。
MANUAL(1)：手动任务。该任务不会被日常调度。
PAUSE(2)：冻结任务。该任务被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为失败状态。
SKIP(3)：空跑任务。该任务被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为成功状态。
SKIP_UNCHOOSE(4)：临时工作流中未选择的任务，仅存在于临时工作流中，启动调度时直接被置为成功状态。
SKIP_CYCLE(5)：未到运行周期的周或月任务。该任务被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为成功状态。
CONDITION_UNCHOOSE(6)：上游实例中有分支（IF）节点，但是该下游节点未被分支节点选中，直接置为空跑任务。
REALTIME_DEPRECATED(7)：实时生成的已经过期的周期实例，该类型的任务直接被置为成功状态

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the instance fails to be scheduled
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调度实例失败时的异常信息

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
